how.title: How it works
how.step1: A concierge or guest sends an email to your dedicated address (auto-generated from the venue name).
how.step2: The email reaches our secure webhook. Our AI extracts: name, contact, date, time, treatment, party size, notes.
how.step3: A new entry shows up in /admin/inbox with a confidence score. Ambiguous requests stay manual.
how.step4: The admin clicks "Convert to booking": a booking is created with status 'pending', ready to be assigned to a therapist.

Number of bookings whose treatment date falls within the selected period and venue, across all statuses — cancellations are therefore included here.
The trend compares with the immediately preceding period of the same length.
dashboardKpi.averageBasketHelp: Revenue divided by the number of revenue-generating bookings (excluding cancellations and no-shows). It is an average per booking, not per treatment: a booking with several treatments counts as one.
dashboardKpi.cancellationRateHelp: Share of bookings with the cancelled status among all bookings for the period and venue. No-shows are not counted as cancellations.

dashboardToday.todayHelp: Bookings whose treatment takes place today, for the selected venue. This counter deliberately ignores the period filter. The second figure isolates those with a confirmed status.
dashboardToday.leadTimeHelp: Average number of days between the moment a booking is created and the treatment date. The scope covers bookings created during the period — otherwise bookings made far in advance, precisely the ones that carry the lead time, would be excluded. Negative lead times (same-day treatment entered after the fact) count as zero.
dashboardToday.activeTherapistsHelp: Therapists who have declared availability for today, out of all those attached to the selected venue. This is a declaration of availability, not an actual workload: an available therapist may have no treatment scheduled.
